summary: Correction round for red V9. The P3.2 candidate itself needed no change (packages/workspace 200 tests OK, tests.test_migrate 55 OK). Two causes of the red V9 were found outside P3.2. (1) The golden plan-check was stale, but commit 9877cd4eb in HEAD has since fixed it, so golden check shows no plan-check diff now. (2) bridges/workspace-planner/tests/test_apply.py (P3.1) had a race: the waiting writer and apply compete for a non-fair flock once the holder releases it, so the writer was sometimes legitimately granted the lock before the switch and printed GRANTED while the test required PLANS_MIGRATED. Reproduced 3/3 under CPU load. I rewrote the test so the writer retries until it gets PLANS_MIGRATED and may only see GRANTED before that. After the fix, three normal runs have no CLASH and pass 64/64, and the loop under load passes. I could not identify the 'Ran 36 tests' failure or run V9 itself here: the sandbox masks *.lock/skills.json/package-lock.json with /dev/null (git shows them as modified, git diff exits 128), so skiller-resolve golden cases and affected-tests.py fail in this sandbox only.
